seo.metaTitle: Watermark & document stamp — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Add a visible status stamp (such as Confidential, Approved or Draft) to an image or document page, plus an optional embedded recipient ID. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/crypto/stego-seal-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Watermark & document stamp processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/crypto/stego-seal-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Watermark & document stamp upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Watermark & document stamp executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/crypto/stego-seal-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Watermark & document stamp?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/stego_seal.json or open /tools/stego-seal?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
